verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows an engineering lead creating agent sessions on behalf of another user, such as impersonation, delegated session creation, or assigning a session's owner. The closest item is org/project role assignment for users and API keys (omnara-gh-1). That is an adjacent access-control feature, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create agent sessions on behalf of other users in my organization
